description:
26" Beach Cruiser Bike – Classic Style, Comfort & Durability
Enjoy a smooth and relaxing ride with our 26-inch beach cruiser bike, measuring approximately 80 inches from wheel to wheel. Perfect for cruising around town, along the boardwalk, or on the beach, this cruiser combines timeless style with everyday practicality. The durable steel frame and extra-comfortable saddle make it ideal for daily rides, errands, or leisurely adventures.
Coaster Brake with Disc Brake Mount
Equipped with a reliable coaster brake, this bike is great for beginners and casual riders. It also includes a caliper mount, giving you the option to upgrade to a disc brake later for enhanced stopping power. The brake system is simple, safe, and easy to use—helping you stop smoothly and confidently.
Single-Speed Simplicity
Built for effortless cruising, the single-speed drivetrain delivers a low-maintenance, no-fuss riding experience. Perfect for flat terrain, it lets you enjoy the ride without worrying about gear shifts.
Polished Rims for a Premium Look
The bike features all-polished rims with matching polished spokes, adding a sleek, custom look to your ride. Crafted from high-quality materials, these rims not only look great but also offer lasting durability.
Whether you're commuting, running errands, or just soaking up the sun on a weekend ride, this 26" beach cruiser bike offers style, comfort, and reliability—perfect for both new riders and seasoned cruisers.
